Who We Are
 Everything at BMW TechWorks begins with passion. It transforms a job into a calling. It motivates us to continually reinvent mobility and bring new ideas to life and onto the roads. Passion for collaborative projects turns a team into a strong unit where every viewpoint is appreciated.
Whatever You Aspire To, At BMW TechWorks We Live And Breathe Software And We Offer a Wide Variety Of Departments And Fields Where You Can Share Your Professional Passion With Us. By Delivering Software All The Way From The Idea To The Final Product, We Lead BMW Into The Future Of Digitalization And Mobility. And This Also Means
We search for excellence 
We get involved 
We keep it simple 
We share trust 
 Join BMW TechWorks on our journey of innovation and excellence as we redefine the future of motion, one product at a time. Our engineers are vital to the innovation and digitalization of BMW Group's driving machines, production, sales and banking processes, and you could be part of our evolving teams.
 What Awaits You
Collaborate with the development team to design, execute, and analyse automated test cases using Selenium/Playwright and Cucumber/other automation testing tools
Implement Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles to create efficient and reusable test scripts, ensuring code quality and maintainability
Conduct API testing with automation tooling to verify application functionality and back-end integrations
Track, document, and manage test cases and bug reports within Jira and Xray to support effective communication and workflow among team members
Utilize version control with GitHub to maintain and share test code, collaborating seamlessly with the rest of the team
Work within an IDE to write and refine code, debugging as necessary to enhance automated test accuracy and efficiency 
 What Should You Bring Along
University Degree in Computer Science or a related field
At least 3-4 years of experience on a similar role is required
Proficiency in the following automation scripting languages: Java and JavaScript/TypeScript
Familiarity with Selenium/Playwright and Cucumber for test automation
Basic knowledge of HTML & CSS for front-end validation during testing
Experience with automation for API testing and GitHub for version control
Understanding of Jira and Xray for test management and documentation
Can be helpful to know database-related test scenarios
Strong process orientation and ability to follow structured testing workflows
Detail-oriented with a high degree of attentiveness to test case accuracy and bug tracking
Demonstrated eagerness to learn and adapt to new tools or processes as needed
Patience to thoroughly test, debug, and document findings accurately
Nice to have skills on web-based mobile (mostly iPhone) application testing
Excellent English verbal and written skills
German communication skills will be a plus
 What do we offer?
Challenging projects with which we are shaping the mobility of tomorrow. 
Great team spirit within an international team 
State-of-the-art global IT landscape and processes 
100% implementation of the Agile Working Model methodology 
Wide range of personal & professional development opportunities 
High level of job security 
Work-Life-Balance and flexible working hours. 
Dynamic and highly-motivating work environment
